title: Dorsal Penile Block for Post-Robotic Prostatectomy Foley Discomfort
brief_summary: The indwelling urethral foley is a major source of discomfort following radical prostatectomy. Our hypothesis is that intra-operative dorsal penile nerve block with bupivacaine may decrease immediate post-operative foley discomfort.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* age 40 years and above,
* diagnosis of prostate cancer,
* electing to undergo robot-assisted radical prostatectomy

Exclusion Criteria:

* allergy to bupivacaine or amide-type local anesthetics,
* chronic pain condition,
* recently or currently on narcotics,
* genital abnormalities
